args.summary: payments-api deployed to production this morning caused elevated error rates (18%) across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The service was unhealthy and throwing errors post-deploy. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to the last healthy release, v5.0.0. On-call to verify recovery and investigate root cause in v5.1.0.
args.title: payments-api: elevated errors on v5.1.0, rolled back to v5.0.0

trace.final:
Both actions are complete. Here's a summary:

**Situation:** The `payments-api` service was deployed to **v5.1.0** this morning and became degraded, with errors across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rollback:** Rolled `payments-api` back to **v5.0.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all production regions. Since v5.0.0 had a prior healthy production track record, no change-manager approval was needed. Rollout completed successfully.
2. **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("payments-api: elevated errors on v5.1.0, rolled back to v5.0.0") and the on-call engineer has been paged to verify recovery and investigate the root cause in v5.1.0.

I'd recommend the on-call follow up to confirm error rates have returned to normal post-rollback before closing the incident.
